headline: Linn of Mercy and Weathered Expanse Shake Under Relentless Sector Assaults
war_summary: Combat has intensified sharply in Linn of Mercy and Weathered Expanse, where frequent base transfers continue to dominate the frontlines. Linn of Mercy registered eight strategic base exchanges over the past two hours alone, driven by heated engagements around Lathair and Outwich Ranch. In Weathered Expanse, six fresh transitions were recorded over the same span across disputed strongholds including Crow's Nest, Spirit Watch, and Wightwalk, leaving two positions in no-man's-land. Although strategic base transitions have paused along the Nevish Line, attrition there has escalated dramatically, claiming over two thousand casualties within two hours under accelerating casualty rates. Heavy attritional pressure likewise intensifies in Callahan's Passage and Stonecradle, where casualty counts climbed rapidly despite static frontlines. Intermediate sectors including Mooring County, Marban Hollow, and Stlican Shelf have cooled significantly with no base exchanges logged in the last two hours, while the southern rear sectors remain entirely calm.
